Research Profile

Environmental scientist and geographer with over 10 years of combined research, teaching, and professional experience across academia, watershed management, NGOs, consulting, and international collaboration. My research focuses on agricultural landscapes, water quality, and spatial environmental decision-making. I integrate geospatial analysis, environmental monitoring, machine learning, and process-based modelling to identify environmental risks, prioritize interventions, and evaluate strategies for resilient and sustainable agricultural systems. My work builds on precision conservation, watershed management, groundwater and climate resilience, with a growing focus on Earth observation and GeoAI.

Research Program and Areas of Expertise
Agricultural Landscape Management: Precision and multifunctional conservation; field-level prioritization; nutrient-loss pathways; watershed and landscape resilience.
Geospatial and Data Science: GIS, geostatistics, spatial decision support, machine learning, spatial optimization, and interpretable environmental analytics.
Earth Observation and GeoAI - developing focus: Optical/radar remote sensing, Google Earth Engine, time-series analysis, and GeoAI for agricultural and environmental applications.
Water and Environmental Systems: Water quality, high-frequency monitoring, hydrology, nutrient transport, groundwater, and process-based environmental modelling.
Science-to-Decision Translation: Decision-support systems, policy engagement, monitoring strategy, stakeholder-oriented analysis, and research-to-practice partnerships.
